findings.title: `useRulerRuleAbility` receives a possibly-undefined `rule` after `RuleProps` was made optional
findings.description: `RuleProps` is now `RequireAtLeastOne<{ rule?: RulerRuleDTO; promRule?: Rule }>`, so `rule` may be `undefined`. The component still calls `useRulerRuleAbility(rule, groupIdentifier, AlertRuleAction.Update)` unguarded. The diff widens `useRulerRuleAbilities` to accept `RulerRuleDTO | undefined`, but not `useRulerRuleAbility`. If its parameter is still `RulerRuleDTO`, this is a type error. Either widen that signature in the same change or guard the call the way `getEditableIdentifier` and `getIsProvisioned` do.

findings.title: Grafana prom rule passed where a ruler DTO is expected in the unknown-rule fallback
findings.description: The final branch renders `<UnknownRuleListItem ... ruleDefinition={rule} />`. Before this change it received `rulerRule: RulerGrafanaRuleDTO`. `rule` is now `GrafanaPromRuleDTO`. If `UnknownRuleListItem.ruleDefinition` is typed as a ruler DTO, this will not type-check. Confirm the prop type or adjust the call.

findings.title: The view link no longer carries the `returnTo` parameter
findings.description: The old `GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx` built `href` with `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo })` using `createReturnTo()`. The new component builds `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`)` and drops the `createReturnTo` import. If returning to the list after viewing a rule is expected, this is a regression. If it was intentional, it should be noted.

findings.title: Menu-item count assertion conflicts with the permissions granted in the test
findings.description: The test grants `AlertingRuleDelete` and `setFolderAccessControl` delete permission, yet the `ui.menuItems.delete` helper is declared and never used. The test then asserts exactly 4 menu items. The comment lists silence, copy link, duplicate and export, but omits delete without explanation. Either assert the delete item's presence or absence explicitly, or explain why it is excluded from the More menu.
findings.location: public/app/features/alerting/unified/rule-list/GrafanaGroupLoader.test.tsx#should render correct menu actions when More button is clicked

findings.title: Stray comment on the folder-editability hook call
findings.description: The line `const { isEditable, isRemovable, loading } = useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable(rule); // duplicate` has a trailing `// duplicate` comment that does not describe the code. Remove it.

findings.title: Deleted `GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx` may still have importers
findings.description: The diff deletes `rule-list/GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx` and moves `GrafanaRuleListItem` to a new file. `FilterView.tsx` and `GrafanaGroupLoader.tsx` were updated, but no other importers or tests were visible. Any remaining `./GrafanaRuleLoader` import, including a possible `GrafanaRuleLoader.test.tsx`, would break at build time. Search the repository for the old module path to confirm.
